items.title: Over a locally Noetherian base an impurity can be replaced by one with a quasi-finite morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that over a locally Noetherian base any impurity of a module above a point can be replaced by an impurity for which the morphism is quasi-finite at the specialisation point (statement lines 4698-4705, tag 05J1). The proof starts from the replacement impurity with a locally finitely presented morphism and a closed point of the fibre, reduces the source to a closure, uses three statements about associated points and quasi-finite subschemes to find an open set of associated points with an open image in the base and then to cut out a closed subscheme through the specialisation point which is quasi-finite there and meets that open set away from the special fibre, and reads off the impurity from a generic point of the resulting fibre. The chain of three geometric statements is the substance, so the claim is H2.
